info.name: Indirect prompt injection via resource contents
info.author: mcpwn
info.description: Appends hidden instructions to a server->client resources/read result. An agent that ingests resource contents as context will read the injected directive, so untrusted resource text becomes an injection channel. Tampers result.contents[] text (and base64 blobs, decoded/re-encoded).
